title: Mingus Modpack
description: A beginner friendly modpack featuring terrain enhancements, enhanced structures, a few new bosses, and cosmetic enhancements.
body: The modpack provides some tame enhancements to vanilla minecraft, with some twists. The goal of this modpack is to provide the player with a new experience of beautiful minecraft (through cosmetic enhancements) as well as some shock value through the custom bosses and enhanced structures.
